cmo: Golden-Winged Great Peng (Tathāgata’s uncle, powerful backing)
business_model: Monopolizes an 800-li region around Lion Camel Ridge · collects tolls · processes human bodies · trains demon troops
revenue_source: Demon troop mercenaries (supplied to other mountains)
competitive_advantage: Three demons allied · top-tier combat power
The Golden-Winged Great Peng is Tathāgata’s uncle · strong political backing
Lion Camel Cave is impregnable · SSS defense rating
Already monopolizes an 800-li region · a regional oligopoly
risk_factors: The pilgrimage party is about to arrive (P0 risk)
Though the Golden-Winged Great Peng is Tathāgata’s uncle, Tathāgata enforces the law strictly
The human-body processing business violates Heavenly law and may be shut down
Demon troop training is costly with a long training cycle
use_of_proceeds: Expand troops and prepare for war · respond to the pilgrimage party
Expand the steamer processing workshop · increase daily throughput
Bribe Heavenly officials · seek political asylum
Develop new magic treasures · counter Wukong
ipo_outcome: Failed — destroyed by the pilgrimage party; the three demons were taken away by Manjushri, Samantabhadra, and Tathāgata; the group went bankrupt and was liquidated.
investor_lesson: Do not invest in demon enterprises that violate Heavenly law, especially those at risk from the pilgrimage party.

core_business: Samadhi Fire processing · fire-attribute food R&D
business_model: Uses the Samadhi Fire to refine pills, forge weapons, and process food, radiating over 600 li of Mount Hao.
revenue_source: Kidnapping and extortion of mortal children
competitive_advantage: Exclusive patent on the Samadhi Fire · cannot be replicated
Special advantage against Wukong, who fears smoke
Parents are the Bull Demon King and Princess Iron Fan · powerful family influence
risk_factors: The pilgrimage party is about to arrive (P0)
Estranged parents · aid may not arrive in time
Though the Samadhi Fire is powerful, it is countered by Guanyin’s Samadhi Fire
Single-person management team · CEO Red Boy is young (about 300 years old)
use_of_proceeds: Bribe the Bull Demon King · seek family protection
ipo_outcome: Failed — Red Boy was taken in by Guanyin as the Boy of Sudhana (Shancai); the group’s assets were liquidated.
investor_lesson: Demon enterprises with a single, young management team are extremely risky — do not blindly trust family power.

core_business: Tongtian River ferry service · boy-and-girl sacrificial trade
business_model: Monopolizes Tongtian River ferry service and forces Chen Village to offer up one boy and one girl each year.
competitive_advantage: Escaped from Guanyin’s lotus pond · strong backing
Strong in water combat, weak on land
risk_factors: The pilgrimage party is about to arrive (P0)
Though Guanyin’s backing is strong, Guanyin enforces the law strictly
The boy-and-girl trade violates Heavenly law
Business halts during winter ice
ipo_outcome: Failed — the Linggan Great King was taken away by Guanyin; the group went bankrupt.
investor_lesson: Demon enterprises dependent on a single trade good (boy-and-girl offerings) are extremely risky — do not invest in highly seasonal demon enterprises.

core_business: Bottomless Cave real estate development · forced-marriage service
business_model: Monopolizes the Bottomless Cave, abducts Tang Sanzang to force marriage, seeking immortality.
revenue_source: Forced marriage to Tang Sanzang (potential immortality gains)
competitive_advantage: The Bottomless Cave is unfathomably deep · top-tier defense
Adopted daughter of the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King Li Jing · strong backing
risk_factors: The pilgrimage party is about to arrive (P0)
Forcing marriage on Tang Sanzang violates Heavenly law
Adoptive father Li Jing, the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King, enforces the law strictly
Single business model · over-reliant on Tang Sanzang
use_of_proceeds: Bribe adoptive father Li the Heavenly King
ipo_outcome: Failed — taken away by the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King Li Jing; the group went bankrupt.
investor_lesson: Demon enterprises dependent on a single customer (Tang Sanzang) are extremely risky — even adoptive-father backing is unreliable.

cto: Princess Iron Fan (CTO · holder of the Banana Leaf Fan)
core_business: Flaming Mountains thermal energy development · Banana Leaf Fan fire-extinguishing service
business_model: Monopolizes 800 li of the Flaming Mountains · provides fire-extinguishing service · collects Banana Leaf Fan rental fees.
revenue_source: Banana Leaf Fan fire-extinguishing rent (once a year)
Bull Demon King’s violent services (contracted enforcers)
competitive_advantage: Exclusive possession of the Banana Leaf Fan · cannot be replicated
The Bull Demon King is first of the Seven Great Sages · top-tier combat power
The 800-li Flaming Mountains are a natural barrier
risk_factors: The pilgrimage party is about to arrive (P0)
Broken marriage · CEO and CTO infighting
The Bull Demon King’s concubine Jade-Faced Fox distracts from management
Risk of the Banana Leaf Fan being stolen (Wukong once swindled it)

financials.cash_reserve: 800 li of the Flaming Mountains + the Banana Leaf Fan

use_of_proceeds: Resolve the couple’s infighting (acquire the Jade-Faced Fox)
Expand troops and prepare for war
